question: What is the nature of the Rudras in Sushiva's covering and what happens when their office ends?
premises: In the covering of Sushiva the Rudras are all-knowing and filled with all powers.
When the bondage of their office dissolves, they become peaceful, take the form of Shiva, and are not subject to rebirth.
inference: The Rudras of Sushiva's covering attain final Shiva-like peace when their official bondage ends.
uncertainties: punarbhavinaḥ is read in the doctrinal sense of no further rebirth, following the context.
plain_english: In the covering of Sushiva the Rudras are all-knowing and full of all powers. When the bondage of their office dissolves, they become peaceful, take on the form of Shiva, and are no longer subject to rebirth.
